title: Openfield Test
author: Sayan Dutta

steps.title: Acclimate animals
steps.instruction: Acclimate animals to the behavior room for 30 minutes to minimize the influence of novel environmental stress.

steps.title: Place animals in arena
steps.instruction: Place animals into a square open-field arena subdivided to allow simultaneous monitoring of up to four individuals per session.

steps.title: Conduct open-field test session
steps.instruction: Perform a 12-minute test session while continuously recording behavior with an overhead camera.

substeps.instruction: Designate the first 2 minutes as a habituation period for animals to adjust to the arena.

steps.title: Clean arena
steps.instruction: Thoroughly clean the arena after each session to remove olfactory cues, ensuring no cross-contamination of scent or behavioral influences when transitioning between species.

description: Locomotor activity and related summary statistics were quantified from the final 10 minutes of the recording using EthoVision XT 10 software (Noldus Information Technology).
